offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Bicapack needs a connection to load this page. Check the Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
offline.banner: You're offline — changes can't be saved until the connection is back.

install.title: Add Bicapack to your Home Screen
install.step3: Tap <key>Add</key>, then open Bicapack from your Home Screen.
install.note: The installed app keeps its own sign-in, so you'll sign in once more the first time you open it. Notifications on this device work only in the installed app.
